claim: President Ferdinand Marcos and Dr. Jose Rizal established and founded the WORLD BANK and International Monetary Fund.

sub_claims.question: Who actually established and founded the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund (IMF)?
sub_claims.answer: The World Bank and the IMF were established at the United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference (the Bretton Woods Conference) in July 1944. The principal architects were economists John Maynard Keynes (representing Britain) and Harry Dexter White (representing the United States).

evidence.statement: The United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference, known as the Bretton Woods Conference, was held in July 1944 at the Mount Washington Hotel in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, United States.

John Maynard Keynes, representing the United Kingdom, and Harry Dexter White, representing the United States, were the principal architects of the agreements that established the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund.

sub_claims.question: When did Ferdinand Marcos serve as President of the Philippines, and was he involved in the 1944 Bretton Woods Conference?
sub_claims.answer: Ferdinand Marcos served as President of the Philippines from 1965 to 1986. He was not in power or involved in international diplomacy in 1944, so he could not have founded these institutions.

evidence.statement: Ferdinand Marcos served as the 10th President of the Philippines from December 30, 1965, to February 25, 1986.
In 1944, Ferdinand Marcos was a law student at the University of the Philippines and had not yet held any public office or been involved in international diplomacy.

sub_claims.question: When was Dr. Jose Rizal active, and what was his primary role?
sub_claims.answer: Dr. Jose Rizal was a Filipino nationalist and writer executed in 1896. He was a leading figure in the Philippine nationalist movement in the late 19th century, decades before the World Bank and IMF were created.

evidence.statement: Dr. Jose Rizal was born on June 19, 1861, and was executed by firing squad on December 30, 1896, in Manila, Philippines.
Jose Rizal was a novelist, poet, and ophthalmologist who led the Propaganda Movement for Philippine reforms during the Spanish colonial period in the late 19th century.

sub_claims.question: Is there any known direct, foundational role for either Marcos or Rizal in the creation of the World Bank or IMF?
sub_claims.answer: No, there is no historical record or established knowledge linking either Ferdinand Marcos or Jose Rizal to the founding of the World Bank or the IMF.

evidence.statement: Historical records of the Bretton Woods Conference list the attendees and participants, and neither Ferdinand Marcos nor Jose Rizal is included in these records.
The World Bank and the International Monetary Fund were founded in 1944, over 48 years after Jose Rizal's death in 1896 and before Ferdinand Marcos entered politics in the late 1940s.
